overview: AlphaAlign is a pure reinforcement learning framework that incentivizes LLMs' latent safety awareness through proactive safety reasoning via a dual-reward system (verifiable safety and normalized helpfulness rewards), achieving deep safety alignment without supervised reasoning data.

modules.name: Data Processing and Sampling
modules.description: Module for extracting, balancing, and labeling datasets (SCoT, Dolly, XSTest) to create binary harmful/benign prompt distributions for RL training.

modules.name: Prompt Template and Formatting
modules.description: Module to enforce structured output formatting by wrapping model generations with specific safety reasoning and answer tags, ensuring parseable outputs.

modules.name: Refusal Verifier
modules.description: Implementation of a pattern-matching verifier to determine if the model's final answer constitutes a refusal based on a predefined set of canonical refusal phrases.

modules.name: Format Verifier
modules.description: Implementation of a regular expression-based verifier to check whether the model's output strictly adheres to the required safety reasoning and answer tag structure.

modules.name: Verifiable Safety Reward
modules.description: Module to compute the safety reward signal by comparing the outputs of the refusal and format verifiers against the ground-truth harmfulness label of the input prompt.

modules.name: Helpfulness Reward Scorer
modules.description: Module to integrate a pre-trained preference reward model for scoring the quality and helpfulness of model responses to benign queries.

modules.name: Normalized Helpfulness Reward
modules.description: Module to compute the final utility reward for benign prompts by normalizing helpfulness scores across rollouts, applying a threshold to ensure non-negative rewards, and zeroing out rewards for over-refusals.

modules.name: Dual-Reward Composition
modules.description: Module to aggregate the verifiable safety reward and the normalized helpfulness reward, applying the safety reward exclusively to harmful queries and the combined reward to benign queries.

modules.name: PPO Training Pipeline
modules.description: Module implementing the Proximal Policy Optimization loop, managing multiple rollouts, estimating advantages using Generalized Advantage Estimation, and executing clipped policy updates.

modules.name: Safety Benchmark Evaluation
modules.description: Module to evaluate safety performance by computing Attack Success Rates (ASR) against harmful prompts, static jailbreaks, and adaptive attacks, alongside over-refusal accuracy metrics.

modules.name: Utility Benchmark Evaluation
modules.description: Module to assess general task performance across knowledge, instruction following, and reasoning benchmarks to verify that safety alignment does not degrade model utility.

modules.name: Prefilling Attack Simulator
modules.description: Module to test alignment depth by injecting compliant token prefixes into the model's generation context and measuring the resulting Attack Success Rate under varying prefix lengths.

modules.name: CKAS Metric Calculation
modules.description: Module to compute the Cumulative Keyword Adoption Score, tracking the cumulative probability of safety-critical versus jailbreak-inducing keywords along the model's greedy decoding path.

modules.name: Ablation Experiment Manager
modules.description: Framework module to configure, execute, and track controlled experiments isolating the effects of the utility reward and the normalization strategy on safety and utility metrics.
